items.title: Google's AI search is rapidly becoming the default, new data shows
items.summary: Google’s AI Overviews now appear in 43% of searches, underscoring how quickly AI-generated answers are becoming the default way people discover information online.
items.titleZh: 新数据显示，谷歌的人工智能搜索正迅速成为默认搜索
items.summaryZh: 谷歌的人工智能概览现在出现在43%的搜索中，突显出人工智能生成的答案正迅速成为人们在线发现信息的默认方式。

items.title: Amazon seeks federal approval to launch 5,105 satellites for direct-to-device network
items.summary: The proposed network will partly rely on assets from Globalstar, which Amazon announced plans to acquire in April for roughly $11.6 billion.
items.titleZh: 亚马逊寻求联邦政府批准发射5105颗卫星用于直接到设备网络
items.summaryZh: 拟议中的网络将部分依赖Globalstar的资产，亚马逊于4月宣布计划以约116亿美元收购Globalstar。

items.title: The Chevy Equinox EV is due for an update: Here’s what could change
items.summary: America’s most affordable 315+ mile range electric vehicle is in line for an update. The next-gen Chevy Equinox EV will reportedly be the first to use GM’s all-new platform.
items.titleZh: 雪佛兰Equinox EV即将进行更新：以下是可能发生的变化
items.summaryZh: 美国最实惠的315英里以上续航里程电动汽车即将更新。据报道，下一代雪佛兰Equinox EV将率先使用通用汽车的全新平台。

items.title: CME launches single stock futures enabling investors to trade SpaceX, Micron 23 hours a day
items.summary: CME Group on Monday launched cash-settled single-stock futures on 55 U.S. equities, along with micro-sized contracts on 22 names.
items.titleZh: 芝加哥商品交易所推出单一股票期货，使投资者能够每天23小时交易SpaceX和Micron
items.summaryZh: 芝加哥商品交易所集团周一推出了55只美国股票的现金结算单一股票期货，以及22只股票的微型合约。

items.title: Ilya Sutskever’s Safe Superintelligence partners with Nvidia to scale its AI research
items.summary: After two years in stealth, Safe Superintelligence has announced a long-term partnership with Nvidia as it prepares to scale to its next phase.
items.titleZh: Ilya Sutskever的安全超级智能与Nvidia合作，扩大其人工智能研究
items.summaryZh: 经过两年的隐秘发展，Safe Superintelligence宣布与Nvidia建立长期合作伙伴关系，准备扩展到下一阶段。

items.title: Rivian R2 uses up to 26% more energy than Model Y in real-world test
items.summary:
Out of Spec Reviews put a Rivian R2 Performance and a Tesla Model Y Performance on the same roads on the same afternoon. The R2 used 18% to 26% more energy at every single speed they tested.
That’s awkward, because the two SUVs carry identical EPA efficiency …
items.titleZh: 在实际测试中，Rivian R2的能耗比Model Y高出26%
items.summaryZh: 不符合规格的评论在同一天下午将Rivian R2 Performance和特斯拉Model Y Performance放在同一条路上。R2在他们测试的每一个速度下都多消耗了18%到26%的能量。
